stages.title: Return the passage, not just the paper
stages.narrative: Every design decision defers to one rule: a result must carry (doc_id, section, start_char, end_char) back to the source. A retrieval change that improves ranking but loses provenance is a regression, not a trade — because a claim you cannot point at is a claim the reader cannot check.

metrics.label: With verbatim full text
metrics.note: the rest are abstract + MeSH only

stages.title: The licence gate was rejecting text-mining licences
stages.narrative: The original gate admitted only Creative Commons codes and reported '30 correctly skipped on licence' as if that were good news. TDM is the PMC code for Text and Data Mining — content publishers release specifically for this use — and it was being rejected for the sole reason that it is not Creative Commons. That is backwards. Policies now name the intent.
stages.caveat: If OncoLens is ever commercialised, switch to the commercial policy — the NC-licensed content indexed today is not licensed for that.

stages.title: Bibliographies are a median 19% of full text, and they retrieve well
stages.narrative: Citation strings match queries lexically while containing no findings. Two of the top three hits for 'osimertinib resistance mechanism' were reference entries, not claims. The first detector was tuned by opening articles and judging whether the output looked right — the exact failure mode this project exists to avoid.

metrics.label: Article body preserved
metrics.note: 1.0000 is perfect; the loss is 679 chars of author-contribution boilerplate in one article

stages.title: The publisher already labelled it
stages.narrative: PMC's JATS XML carries <ref-list> — the publisher's own statement of where the bibliography starts. Aligning it onto the plain text turns a matter of taste into a labelled task. The labels showed the signals were never the problem: separation is essentially perfect. The design was wrong.

metrics.label: Signals found to be pure noise
metrics.note: 'numbered entries' and 'volume:page' carried hand-assigned weights of 0.20 and 0.12

stages.title: A 60-article sample certified a rule that failed on 180 documents
stages.narrative: After scoring 60/60 on labelled data, the live index still held 1,394 reference-shaped passages. The mean was unremarkable; the distribution was the diagnostic — 215 in one document, 124 in another. Concentration means undetected bibliographies. Every labelled article had been a primary research paper, and a review inverts the ratio.

metrics.label: Largest single bibliography
metrics.note: PMC10958066 — 80.6% of the document, in one paragraph

stages.caveat: The transferable lesson is about the benchmark, not the threshold: when a component passes its benchmark, check the distribution of its failures on the live corpus.

stages.title: The bibliographies are also the labels
stages.narrative: When an author writes 'resistance to osimertinib is driven by MET amplification [12]', that sentence is a technical description of reference [12] written by someone who read it. It is a query; the cited paper is the answer; the judgment is free and expert — and claim-level, where MeSH is only document-level topical. Not circular: labels come from JATS <xref> markup, while retrieval indexes the plain text where markers are already flattened away.

metrics.label: Yield before snowball ingestion
metrics.note: 3 labels from 4,973 contexts — 4,967 cited papers we did not hold

guards.hazard: The citing paper contains the query verbatim

guards.guard: report bpref and unjudged@k alongside nDCG, never nDCG alone
grade falls with co-citation; more than 3 co-cited is dropped
rejected — an assertive verb is required

stages.title: Measured on 2,225 expert-written queries
stages.narrative: Systems are compared on identical queries with a paired permutation test and a bootstrap confidence interval. With this many queries a two-point nDCG gap is still routinely noise, and shipping on a point estimate is how retrieval systems silently get worse.
stages.caveat: Benchmark has not been run against this index yet — no numbers are shown rather than stale ones.

stages.title: Neon is right for now, and the limit is already visible
stages.narrative: This corpus is relational — grants, publications, PIs, institutions — and those joins are half the product, which is the real argument for Postgres over a pure vector store. The cost is that ts_rank_cd is not BM25, so the offline harness and production score differently. The free tier's ceiling arrived exactly where the storage note predicted.

metrics.label: Unused index removed
metrics.note: GIN trigram index, idx_scan = 0 — 20% of the database

stages.caveat: Full text lives in Vercel Blob, not Postgres: it is large, immutable and never queried — only fetched once a passage has already been retrieved.
